name: Natura Beach Bar

en.name: Natura Beach Bar
en.tagline: From sunny beach days to memorable sunsets
en.short: A relaxed beach bar on the western coast of Thassos, with sunbeds, Greek summer flavors, coffee, cocktails and sunset views.
en.description: Spend a beach day by the Aegean at Natura Beach Bar, near Skala Prinos. Enjoy a drink beneath the straw parasols, choose from casual dishes, and linger into the golden evening. The surrounding greenery and open sea make this a welcoming stop for couples, families and groups.

ro.name: Natura Beach Bar
ro.tagline: De la zile însorite pe plajă la apusuri memorabile
ro.short: Beach bar relaxant pe coasta vestică a insulei Thassos, cu șezlonguri, preparate pentru zile de vară, cafea, cocktailuri și priveliști la apus.
ro.description: Petrece o zi pe malul Mării Egee la Natura Beach Bar, în apropiere de Skala Prinos. Savurează o băutură sub umbrelele de paie, alege preparate lejere și bucură-te de lumina caldă a serii. Verdeața și marea deschisă creează un loc plăcut pentru cupluri, familii și grupuri.

el.name: Natura Beach Bar
el.tagline: Από τις ηλιόλουστες μέρες στην παραλία στα αξέχαστα ηλιοβασιλέματα
el.short: Χαλαρό beach bar στη δυτική ακτή της Θάσου, με ξαπλώστρες, καφέ, κοκτέιλ, φαγητό και όμορφα ηλιοβασιλέματα.
el.description: Απολαύστε μια μέρα δίπλα στο Αιγαίο στο Natura Beach Bar, κοντά στη Σκάλα Πρίνου. Καθίστε κάτω από τις ψάθινες ομπρέλες, δοκιμάστε χαλαρές γεύσεις και μείνετε ως το ηλιοβασίλεμα.

de.name: Natura Beach Bar
de.short: Entspannte Strandbar an der Westküste von Thassos mit Liegen, Kaffee, Cocktails, kleinen Gerichten und Sonnenuntergangsblick.
de.description: Genießen Sie einen Tag am Ägäischen Meer in der Natura Beach Bar nahe Skala Prinos. Entspannen Sie unter Strohdächern, probieren Sie unkomplizierte Gerichte und bleiben Sie bis zum Sonnenuntergang.

bg.name: Natura Beach Bar
bg.tagline: Слънчеви дни на плажа и незабравими залези
bg.short: Спокоен плажен бар на западния бряг на Тасос с шезлонги, кафе, коктейли, храна и гледки към залеза.
bg.description: Прекарайте ден край Егейско море в Natura Beach Bar, близо до Скала Принос. Отпуснете се под сламените чадъри, опитайте леки ястия и останете за красивия залез.

sr.name: Natura Beach Bar
sr.tagline: Sunčani dani na plaži i nezaboravni zalasci sunca
sr.short: Opušten bar na plaži na zapadnoj obali Tasosa, sa ležaljkama, kafom, koktelima, hranom i pogledom na zalazak sunca.
sr.description: Provedite dan uz Egejsko more u Natura Beach Baru, blizu Skale Prinos. Odmorite se pod slamnatim suncobranima, uživajte u laganim jelima i ostanite do zalaska sunca.
